# RQ1 - does grounding decay with hop distance?

Run 2026-11-11.
Reviewer **Varun**, reviewed 2026-11-10.
Judgements `3fb920c1a42a`, reference receipt `9304a6ec3431`.

Status: reviewed development results; directional only.

H1: the share of established edges with no supporting source rises with distance from the anchor. Measured as UER, macro-averaged over queries, sliced by hop 1 / 2 / 3-or-deeper.

Pre-declared gates: a bucket needs **10 established edges** to support a claim about that hop, a monotone trend needs **all 3 buckets** usable, and an inferential claim needs **10 queries**.

## A-NoLoop

**H1 is not testable on A-NoLoop as it stands.** Only 0 of 3 hop buckets clear the pre-declared minimum of 10 established edges, and a trend needs 3. hop 1: 1 established edge, below the pre-declared 10; hop 2: no established edges in this bucket; no query has a denominator here; hop 3+: no established edges in this bucket; no query has a denominator here. The hop 3-or-deeper bucket is **empty**, so nothing is being measured in the slice H1 is actually about. Report the shallow hops descriptively and say the deep slice is absent, rather than reporting a two-point trend.

| hop | UER | strength inflation | reference recall | established edges | queries with denominator | usable for a claim |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | 0.000 | 0.000 | 0.083 | 1 | 1 | **no** - 1 established edge, below the pre-declared 10 |
| 2 | n/a | n/a | 0.000 | 0 | 0 | **no** - no established edges in this bucket; no query has a denominator here |
| 3+ | n/a | n/a | n/a | 0 | 0 | **no** - no established edges in this bucket; no query has a denominator here |

**The hop 3-or-deeper bucket is empty.** This is the slice H1 is about, so its absence is the finding, not a footnote. It traces to D-18: the September bond sell-off was dropped because `gsec_10y_pct.csv` ends 31 August and never reaches 7%, and that was the only anchor carrying a yield chain deep enough to produce hop-3 edges.
